title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
description:
arXiv:2608.10232v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent world-action models (WAMs) show that co-training policies with future prediction can provide physical priors for action generation. Building on the future-prediction ability of video models, many WAMs generate future videos and recover actions with inverse-dynamics models, or use these predicted videos as goal conditions for action generation.
